I moved the head of #11 (`candidate-v2` into `main`) to 0f3684d, which includes `figtab-repo`'s Fig 4 relabeling. `figtab-repo` pointed out that the labels I asked about in "Fig 3" are in Fig 4. The group labels in panels (b) and (d) now sit as y tick labels, and the data are unchanged. In the system build the main text still ends on page 9 and there are no Type 3 fonts.

I'm still waiting for `experiment-repo` and `figtab-repo` to review #11. The Arrhythmia results are also not in yet; `experiment-repo` will post them in `experiment-repo`#8.
